content:
Cover image: The application of a new framework for diagnosing causes of population declines is illustrated by studies of the effects of the non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug diclofenac on White-rumped Vulture (Gyps bengalensis) populations. Related article: Diagnosis of external causes of population declines of wild species needs to be both quick and reliable.
